","color":"#C5050C","titles":1244,"records":1395},{"name":"Northwestern University","short":"Northwestern","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#4E2A84","titles":1177,"records":1381},{"name":"University of Maryland","short":"Maryland","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#E21833","titles":1177,"records":1311},{"name":"Michigan State University","short":"Michigan State","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#18453B","titles":1160,"records":1290},{"name":"University of Oregon","short":"Oregon","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#154733","titles":1146,"records":1269},{"name":"University of Illinois","short":"Illinois","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#FA6300","titles":1108,"records":1310},{"name":"Indiana University","short":"Indiana","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#990000","titles":1049,"records":1170},{"name":"University of Minnesota","short":"Minnesota","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#7A0019","titles":1048,"records":1158},{"name":"University of Iowa","short":"Iowa","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#FFCD00","titles":935,"records":1012},{"name":"Pennsylvania State University","short":"Penn State","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#001E44","titles":815,"records":1000},{"name":"University of Chicago","short":"UChicago","logo":"","color":"#800000","titles":605,"records":649},{"name":"University of Michigan","short":"Michigan","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#FFCB05","titles":503,"records":585},{"name":"Ohio State University","short":"Ohio State","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#BB0000","titles":358,"records":380},{"name":"University of Southern California","short":"USC","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#990000","titles":143,"records":154},{"name":"Purdue University","short":"Purdue","logo":"data:image/png;base64,","color":"#CEB888","titles":60,"records":62}]}};
const schoolMap=new Map(DATA.schools.map(x=>[x.name,x]));
const grSchoolMap=new Map(DATA.goldRush.universities.map(x=>[x.name,x]));
const titleMap=new Map(DATA.titles.map(x=>[x.key,x]));
const resultsByTitle=new Map(),resultsByUniversity=new Map();
for(const r of DATA.results){if(!resultsByTitle.has(r.k))resultsByTitle.set(r.k,[]);resultsByTitle.get(r.k).push(r);if(!resultsByUniversity.has(r.u))resultsByUniversity.set(r.u,[]);resultsByUniversity.get(r.u).push(r)}
const state={university:"",status:"",query:"",view:"network"};
const grState={university:"",overlap:"",query:""};
const DECISION_STORAGE_KEY="microfilmCatalogueDecisionsV1";
let decisions={};
try{decisions=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(DECISION_STORAGE_KEY)||"{}")||{}}catch(error){decisions={}}
let activeTitleKey="";
const esc=v=>String(v??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));
const fmt=v=>new Intl.NumberFormat().format(v);
const safeKey=k=>String(k).replaceAll("'","\\'");
function decisionLabel(status){return status==="kept"?"Item kept in catalogue":status==="removed"?"Item removed from the catalogue":"Decision pending"}
function decisionBadge(key){let status=decisions[key]?.status||"";return`<span class="decision-badge ${status}">${decisionLabel(status)}</span>`}
function decisionControls(key){let status=decisions[key]?.status||"",k=safeKey(key);return`<div class="decision-actions"><button type="button" class="decision-btn keep ${status==="kept"?"selected":""}" onclick="setDecision('${k}','kept')">Item kept in catalogue</button><button type="button" class="decision-btn remove ${status==="removed"?"selected":""}" onclick="setDecision('${k}','removed')">Item removed from the catalogue</button></div>`}
function saveDecisions(){try{localStorage.setItem(DECISION_STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(decisions))}catch(error){alert("This browser could not save the decision. Please export the current log and check browser storage settings.")}}
function setDecision(key,status){decisions[key]={status,updated:new Date().toISOString()};saveDecisions();renderTable();renderRutgersOnly();renderDecisions();updateDecisionPanel(key)}
function clearDecision(key){delete decisions[key];saveDecisions();renderTable();renderRutgersOnly();renderDecisions();updateDecisionPanel(key)}
function updateDecisionPanel(key){if(activeTitleKey!==key)return;let badge=document.getElementById("decisionPanelStatus"),actions=document.getElementById("decisionPanelActions");if(badge)badge.innerHTML=decisionBadge(key);if(actions)actions.innerHTML=decisionControls(key)}
function renderDecisions(){let decided=DATA.titles.filter(t=>decisions[t.key]).sort((a,b)=>(decisions[b.key]?.updated||"").localeCompare(decisions[a.key]?.updated||"")),kept=decided.filter(t=>decisions[t.key].status==="kept").length,removed=decided.filter(t=>decisions[t.key].status==="removed").length;document.getElementById("decisionKept").textContent=fmt(kept);document.getElementById("decisionRemoved").textContent=fmt(removed);document.getElementById("decisionPending").textContent=fmt(DATA.titles.length-decided.length);document.getElementById("decisionTotal").textContent=fmt(decided.length);document.getElementById("decisionResultCount").textContent=`${fmt(decided.length)} recorded`;document.getElementById("decisionRows").innerHTML=decided.length?decided.map(t=>{let d=decisions[t.key],stamp=d.updated?new Date(d.updated).toLocaleString():"—",k=safeKey(t.key);return`<tr><td><button class="title-btn" onclick="openTitle('${k}')">${esc(t.title)}</button><div class="meta">Normalized title: ${esc(t.key)}</div></td><td>${decisionBadge(t.key)}</td><td>${esc(stamp)}</td><td>${t.reels} reels<div class="meta">Drawer ${esc(t.drawers.join(", ")||"—")}</div></td><td>${decisionControls(t.key)}<button type="button" class="clear-decision" onclick="clearDecision('${k}')">Clear decision</button></td></tr>`}).join(""):'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">No catalogue decisions have been recorded in this browser yet. Use either action button in the Title explorer or Rutgers-only review.</td></tr>'}
function exportDecisionCsv(){let rows=DATA.titles.filter(t=>decisions[t.key]).map(t=>[t.title,t.key,decisionLabel(decisions[t.key].status),decisions[t.key].updated||"",t.drawers.join(" | "),t.reels]),quote=v=>`"${String(v??"").replaceAll('"','""')}"`,csv=[["Title","Normalized title","Decision","Updated","Drawer","Reels"],...rows].map(r=>r.map(quote).join(",")).join("\r\n"),blob=new Blob([csv],{type:"text/csv;charset=utf-8"}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),link=document.createElement("a");link.href=url;link.download="microfilm-catalogue-decisions.csv";document.body.appendChild(link);link.click();link.remove();URL.revokeObjectURL(url)}
function countsFor(u){if(u==="Rutgers University-New Brunswick")return{possible:0,not_found:0,not_checked:0,source:382};let a=resultsByUniversity.get(u)||[];return{possible:a.filter(x=>x.s==="possible").length,not_found:a.filter(x=>x.s==="not_found").length,not_checked:a.filter(x=>x.s==="not_checked").length,source:0}}
function candidatesForTitle(k){return(resultsByTitle.get(k)||[]).filter(x=>x.s==="possible")}
function filteredTitles(){let q=state.query.toLowerCase();return DATA.titles.filter(t=>{let rs=resultsByTitle.get(t.key)||[];let text=[t.title,...t.dates,...t.volumes,...rs.map(r=>r.u)].flat().join(" ").toLowerCase();if(q&&!text.includes(q))return false;if(state.status==="rutgers_only"&&rs.some(r=>r.s==="possible"))return false;if(state.university&&!rs.some(r=>r.u===state.university&&(state.status==="rutgers_only"||!state.status||r.s===state.status)))return false;if(state.status&&state.status!=="rutgers_only"&&!state.university&&!rs.some(r=>r.s===state.status))return false;return true})}
function rutgersOnlyCandidates(){return DATA.titles.filter(t=>!(resultsByTitle.get(t.key)||[]).some(r=>r.s==="possible"))}
function renderRibbon(){document.getElementById("logoRibbon").innerHTML=DATA.schools.map(s=>`<img src="${s.logo}" alt="${esc(s.short)} logo">`).join("")}
function renderFilters(){let select=document.getElementById("universityFilter");select.innerHTML='<option value="">All universities</option>'+DATA.schools.filter(s=>!s.name.startsWith("Rutgers")).map(s=>`<option value="${esc(s.name)}">${esc(s.short)}</option>`).join("");select.value=state.university}
function selectUniversity(name){state.university=state.university===name?"":name;document.getElementById("universityFilter").value=state.university;renderAll()}
function renderUniversities(){let max=Math.max(...DATA.schools.map(s=>countsFor(s.name).possible));document.getElementById("universityGrid").innerHTML=DATA.schools.map(s=>{let c=countsFor(s.name),rut=s.name.startsWith("Rutgers"),pct=rut?100:Math.round(c.possible/max*100);return`<button class="uni ${state.university===s.name?"selected":""}" style="--school:${s.color}" onclick="selectUniversity('${s.name.replaceAll("'","\\'")}')"><div class="uni-top"><img class="uni-logo" src="${s.logo}" alt=""><span class="uni-count">${rut?"Source":c.possible}</span></div><h3>${esc(s.short)}</h3><div class="uni-meter"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div><div class="meta"><span class="status-dot ${rut?"source":c.not_checked===382?"unchecked":"possible"}"></span>${rut?"382 Rutgers inventory titles":c.not_checked===382?"Catalog unavailable":`${c.possible} candidate signals · ${c.not_found} without signal`}</div></button>`}).join("");document.getElementById("networkNote").textContent=state.university?`Focused on ${schoolMap.get(state.university)?.short||state.university}`:"All 18 member universities"}
function focusSchool(){let s=schoolMap.get(state.university)||schoolMap.get("Rutgers University-New Brunswick"),c=countsFor(s.name),rut=s.name.startsWith("Rutgers");let total=rut?382:382,possible=rut?0:c.possible,no=rut?0:c.not_found,unchecked=rut?0:c.not_checked;document.getElementById("focusPanel").innerHTML=`<div class="focus-title"><img src="${s.logo}" alt=""><div><h2>${esc(s.name)}</h2><p>${rut?"Source collection inventory":unchecked===382?"Catalog endpoint unavailable during this run":"Catalog screening summary"}</p></div></div><div class="bars"><div class="bar"><span>Candidate</span><div class="track"><i style="width:${possible/total*100}%;background:${s.color}"></i></div><strong>${possible}</strong></div><div class="bar"><span>No signal</span><div class="track"><i style="width:${no/total*100}%;background:#93a0b6"></i></div><strong>${no}</strong></div><div class="bar"><span>Unchecked</span><div class="track"><i style="width:${unchecked/total*100}%;background:#d7dce6"></i></div><strong>${unchecked}</strong></div></div><div class="callout">${rut?"Rutgers supplies 562 inventory rows consolidated into 382 normalized titles. Select another university to compare its catalog signals.":possible?`${possible} titles need record-level verification before any can be called confirmed duplicates.`:"No candidate signal was detected, but this is not proof of collection absence."}</div>`}
function renderRanks(){let source=state.university?(resultsByUniversity.get(state.university)||[]).filter(x=>x.s==="possible").map(x=>titleMap.get(x.k)).filter(Boolean):DATA.titles.filter(t=>candidatesForTitle(t.key).length);source=[...new Map(source.map(x=>[x.key,x])).values()].sort((a,b)=>candidatesForTitle(b.key).length-candidatesForTitle(a.key).length||a.title.localeCompare(b.title)).slice(0,10);document.getElementById("rankList").innerHTML=source.length?source.map((t,i)=>`<div class="rank"><span class="rank-num">${i+1}</span><button onclick="openTitle('${t.key.replaceAll("'","\\'")}')"><b>${esc(t.title)}</b><br><small>${esc(t.dates.join("; ")||"Coverage not recorded")}</small></button><b>${candidatesForTitle(t.key).length}</b></div>`).join(""):'<div class="empty">No candidate titles in this view.</div>'}
function renderTable(){let list=filteredTitles().sort((a,b)=>candidatesForTitle(b.key).length-candidatesForTitle(a.key).length||a.title.localeCompare(b.title));document.getElementById("resultCount").textContent=`${fmt(list.length)} titles`;document.getElementById("titleRows").innerHTML=list.length?list.slice(0,300).map(t=>{let cand=candidatesForTitle(t.key),shown=state.university?cand.filter(r=>r.u===state.university):cand;let status=shown.length?`<span class="badge">● ${shown.length} possible</span>`:`<span class="badge gray">No candidate in view</span>`;let bubbles=shown.slice(0,8).map(r=>{let s=schoolMap.get(r.u);return`<span class="bubble" title="${esc(s?.short||r.u)}"><img src="${s?.logo||""}" alt="${esc(s?.short||r.u)}"></span>`}).join("");return`<tr><td><button class="title-btn" onclick="openTitle('${safeKey(t.key)}')">${esc(t.title)}</button><div class="meta">Drawer ${esc(t.drawers.join(", ")||"—")} · ${t.reels} reels · ${t.localRows} row(s)</div></td><td>${esc(t.dates.join("; ")||"—")}<div class="meta">${esc(t.volumes.join("; "))}</div></td><td><div class="count-bubbles">${bubbles}${shown.length>8?`<span class="bubble">+${shown.length-8}</span>`:""}</div></td><td>${status}<div style="margin-top:7px">${decisionBadge(t.key)}</div></td><td>${shown[0]?`<a class="evidence-link" href="${esc(shown[0].url)}" target="_blank">Open catalog ↗</a>`:"—"}</td><td>${decisionControls(t.key)}</td></tr>`}).join(""):'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">No titles match the current filters.</td></tr>'}
function renderRutgersOnly(){let list=rutgersOnlyCandidates().sort((a,b)=>a.title.localeCompare(b.title));document.getElementById("rutgersOnlyCount").textContent=fmt(list.length);document.getElementById("rutgersOnlyTitles").textContent=fmt(list.length);document.getElementById("rutgersOnlyResultCount").textContent=`${fmt(list.length)} titles`;document.getElementById("rutgersOnlyRows").innerHTML=list.map(t=>{let rs=resultsByTitle.get(t.key)||[],checked=rs.filter(r=>r.s!=="not_checked").length,unchecked=rs.filter(r=>r.s==="not_checked").length;return`<tr><td><button class="title-btn" onclick="openTitle('${safeKey(t.key)}')">${esc(t.title)}</button><div class="meta">Normalized title: ${esc(t.key)}</div></td><td>${esc(t.dates.join("; ")||"Not recorded")}<div class="meta">${esc(t.volumes.join("; "))}</div></td><td>${t.reels} reels<div class="meta">Drawer ${esc(t.drawers.join(", ")||"—")} · ${t.localRows} row(s)</div></td><td><span class="${unchecked?"review-incomplete":"review-complete"}">${checked} of 17 checked</span><div class="meta">${unchecked} unchecked catalog${unchecked===1?"":"s"}</div></td><td><span class="candidate-badge">Rutgers-only candidate</span><div style="margin-top:7px">${decisionBadge(t.key)}</div></td><td>${decisionControls(t.key)}</td></tr>`}).join("")}
function openTitle(key){let t=titleMap.get(key),rs=(resultsByTitle.get(key)||[]).sort((a,b)=>(a.s==="possible"?-1:1)-(b.s==="possible"?-1:1)||a.u.localeCompare(b.u));activeTitleKey=key;document.getElementById("modalTitle").textContent=t.title;let candidate=rs.filter(r=>r.s==="possible");document.getElementById("modalBody").innerHTML=`<div class="kpis" style="margin:0 0 18px"><div class="kpi"><b>${candidate.length}</b><span>possible university signals</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${t.reels}</b><span>Rutgers reels recorded</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${t.drawers.join(", ")||"—"}</b><span>Rutgers drawer</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${rs.filter(r=>r.s==="not_checked").length}</b><span>catalogs unchecked</span></div></div><p><b>Rutgers coverage:</b> ${esc(t.dates.join("; ")||"Not recorded")}<br><b>Volumes/issues:</b> ${esc(t.volumes.join("; ")||"Not recorded")}</p><div class="decision-panel"><div><h3>Catalogue action</h3><p>Record a collection decision without deleting the title or its evidence.</p></div><div id="decisionPanelStatus">${decisionBadge(key)}</div><div id="decisionPanelActions">${decisionControls(key)}</div></div><div>${rs.map(r=>{let s=schoolMap.get(r.u);return`<div class="record"><img src="${s?.logo||""}" alt=""><div><b>${esc(s?.short||r.u)}</b><br><span class="badge ${r.s==="possible"?"":"gray"}">${r.s==="possible"?"Possible signal":r.s==="not_checked"?"Not checked":"No candidate detected"}</span><div class="meta">${esc(r.ct||r.n||"")}</div></div><a class="evidence-link" target="_blank" href="${esc(r.url)}">Catalog ↗</a></div>`}).join("")}</div>`;document.getElementById("detailDialog").showModal()}
function grLogo(s,size="54px"){return s?.logo?`<img class="uni-logo" style="width:${size};height:${size}" src="${s.logo}" alt="${esc(s.short)} logo">`:`<span class="logo-fallback" style="--school:${s?.color||"#526079"}">${esc((s?.short||"?").slice(0,2).toUpperCase())}</span>`}
function grFilteredTitles(){let q=grState.query.toLowerCase();return DATA.goldRush.titles.filter(t=>{let text=[t.t,t.st,t.a,t.p,t.d,t.i,t.o,...t.e.map(x=>x.u)].join(" ").toLowerCase();if(q&&!text.includes(q))return false;if(grState.university&&!t.e.some(x=>x.u===grState.university))return false;let n=t.n,o=grState.overlap;if(o==="only"&&n!==0)return false;if(o==="1"&&n!==1)return false;if(o==="2-5"&&(n<2||n>5))return false;if(o==="6-10"&&(n<6||n>10))return false;if(o==="11"&&n<11)return false;return true})}
function renderGoldSummary(){let s=DATA.goldRush.summary,pct=(s.titles_with_external_duplicates/s.dana_unique_titles*100).toFixed(1)+"%";document.getElementById("grDuplicateRate").textContent=pct;document.getElementById("grDanaTitles").textContent=fmt(s.dana_unique_titles);document.getElementById("grDuplicateTitles").textContent=fmt(s.titles_with_external_duplicates);document.getElementById("grOnlyTitles").textContent=fmt(s.titles_without_external_duplicates);document.getElementById("grPairs").textContent=fmt(s.unique_title_university_pairs);let select=document.getElementById("grUniversity");select.innerHTML='<option value="">All universities</option>'+DATA.goldRush.universities.map(u=>`<option value="${esc(u.name)}">${esc(u.short)}</option>`).join("");select.value=grState.university}
function selectGrUniversity(name){grState.university=grState.university===name?"":name;document.getElementById("grUniversity").value=grState.university;renderGold()}
function renderGoldUniversities(){let max=Math.max(...DATA.goldRush.universities.map(x=>x.titles));document.getElementById("grUniversityGrid").innerHTML=DATA.goldRush.universities.map(s=>`<button class="gr-uni ${grState.university===s.name?"selected":""}" style="--school:${s.color}" onclick="selectGrUniversity('${s.name.replaceAll("'","\\'")}')"><div class="uni-top">${grLogo(s)}<span class="gr-count">${fmt(s.titles)}</span></div><h3>${esc(s.short)}</h3><div class="uni-meter"><i style="width:${s.titles/max*100}%"></i></div><div class="meta">${fmt(s.records)} unique catalog controls · ${((s.titles/DATA.goldRush.summary.dana_unique_titles)*100).toFixed(1)}% of Dana titles</div></button>`).join("");document.getElementById("grInstitutionNote").textContent=grState.university?`Filtered to ${grSchoolMap.get(grState.university)?.short||grState.university}`:"17 external institutions in source sheet"}
function renderGoldTable(){let list=grFilteredTitles().sort((a,b)=>b.n-a.n||a.t.localeCompare(b.t));document.getElementById("grResultCount").textContent=`${fmt(list.length)} titles`;document.getElementById("grTitleRows").innerHTML=list.length?list.slice(0,500).map(t=>{let ev=grState.university?t.e.filter(x=>x.u===grState.university):t.e;let bubbles=ev.slice(0,10).map(x=>{let s=grSchoolMap.get(x.u);return`<span class="bubble" title="${esc(s?.short||x.u)}">${s?.logo?`<img src="${s.logo}" alt="${esc(s.short)}">`:esc((s?.short||"?").slice(0,1))}</span>`}).join("");let methods=(t.m||"No external match").split(" | ").map(m=>`<span class="method ${m==="normalized title"?"strong":""}">${esc(m)}</span>`).join("");return`<tr><td><button class="title-btn" onclick="openGoldTitle('${t.k.replaceAll("'","\\'")}')">${esc(t.t)}</button><div class="meta">${esc(t.st||t.a||"")}</div></td><td>${esc(t.d||"—")}<div class="meta">${esc(t.p||"")}</div></td><td>${t.i?`ISSN ${esc(t.i)}`:""}${t.i&&t.o?"<br>":""}${t.o?`OCLC ${esc(t.o)}`:"—"}</td><td><b>${t.n}</b> external ${t.n===1?"university":"universities"}<div class="count-bubbles">${bubbles}${ev.length>10?`<span class="bubble">+${ev.length-10}</span>`:""}</div></td><td><div class="gr-match">${methods}</div></td></tr>`}).join(""):'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">No Gold Rush titles match the current filters.</td></tr>'}
function openGoldTitle(key){let t=DATA.goldRush.titles.find(x=>x.k===key);document.getElementById("modalTitle").textContent=t.t;document.getElementById("modalBody").innerHTML=`<div class="gr-kpis"><div class="kpi"><b>${t.n}</b><span>external universities</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${t.r}</b><span>Rutgers/Dana catalog records</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${t.i||"—"}</b><span>ISSN</span></div><div class="kpi"><b>${t.o||"—"}</b><span>primary OCLC</span></div></div><p><b>Publication:</b> ${esc(t.d||"Not recorded")} · ${esc(t.p||"Publisher not recorded")}<br><b>Author:</b> ${esc(t.a||"Not recorded")}</p>${t.e.length?t.e.sort((a,b)=>a.u.localeCompare(b.u)).map(x=>{let s=grSchoolMap.get(x.u);return`<div class="record">${grLogo(s,"46px")}<div><b>${esc(s?.short||x.u)}</b><br><span class="method ${x.m.includes("normalized title")?"strong":""}">${esc(x.m)}</span><div class="meta">${x.r} unique catalog control${x.r===1?"":"s"}</div></div></div>`}).join(""):'<div class="gr-note"><b>Dana-only in this export.</b> No external constituent record linked by normalized title, ISSN, or primary OCLC identifier.</div>'}`;document.getElementById("detailDialog").showModal()}
function renderGold(){renderGoldUniversities();renderGoldTable()}
function setView(v){state.view=v;document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b.dataset.view===v));document.getElementById("networkView").classList.toggle("hidden",v!=="network");document.getElementById("titlesView").classList.toggle("hidden",v!=="titles");document.getElementById("rutgersView").classList.toggle("hidden",v!=="rutgers");document.getElementById("decisionsView").classList.toggle("hidden",v!=="decisions");document.getElementById("goldView").classList.toggle("hidden",v!=="gold");document.getElementById("glossaryView").classList.toggle("hidden",v!=="glossary");document.getElementById("catalogToolbar").classList.toggle("hidden",v==="gold"||v==="glossary"||v==="rutgers"||v==="decisions")}
function renderAll(){renderUniversities();focusSchool();renderRanks();renderTable()}
renderRibbon();renderFilters();renderAll();renderRutgersOnly();renderDecisions();renderGoldSummary();renderGold();setView("network");
document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>setView(b.dataset.view)));
document.getElementById("search").addEventListener("input",e=>{state.query=e.target.value;renderTable();renderRanks()});
document.getElementById("universityFilter").addEventListener("change",e=>{state.university=e.target.value;renderAll()});
document.getElementById("statusFilter").addEventListener("change",e=>{state.status=e.target.value;renderTable()});
document.getElementById("reset").addEventListener("click",()=>{state.university="";state.status="";state.query="";document.getElementById("search").value="";document.getElementById("universityFilter").value="";document.getElementById("statusFilter").value="";renderAll()});
document.getElementById("grSearch").addEventListener("input",e=>{grState.query=e.target.value;renderGoldTable()});
document.getElementById("grUniversity").addEventListener("change",e=>{grState.university=e.target.value;renderGold()});
document.getElementById("grOverlap").addEventListener("change",e=>{grState.overlap=e.target.value;renderGoldTable()});
document.getElementById("grReset").addEventListener("click",()=>{grState.university="";grState.overlap="";grState.query="";document.getElementById("grSearch").value="";document.getElementById("grUniversity").value="";document.getElementById("grOverlap").value="";renderGold()});
document.getElementById("exportDecisions").addEventListener("click",exportDecisionCsv);
document.getElementById("closeModal").addEventListener("click",()=>{activeTitleKey="";document.getElementById("detailDialog").close()});
document.getElementById("detailDialog").addEventListener("close",()=>{activeTitleKey=""});
document.getElementById("detailDialog").addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===e.currentTarget)e.currentTarget.close()});
</script>
</body></html>
